Built where the road to Brandenburg once began

The Brandenburg Gate was built from 1788 to 1791 for Frederick William II and is crowned by Schadow's bronze quadriga.

Several hundred cisterns lie under this city

The Basilica Cistern, built in the 6th century under Justinian I, is the largest of Istanbul's ancient cisterns.

📍 Basilica Cistern, Istanbul
